subject: Default levels of kde estimates in geom_density2d

messages.author: 637c00088bba8c56
messages.subject: Default levels of kde estimates in geom_density2d
parts:
Dear,

What are the default levels used by geom_density2d? As in this code:

p <- ggplot(mdsdata2d)
p <- p + geom_density2d(aes(x = coord1, y = coord2, group = patient,
colour = progression.time))
p <- p + scale_colour_manual(values = c(
"60" = "red",
"72" = "gold",
"78" = "olivedrab3",
"84" = "green2",
"96" = "turquoise1",
"132" = "blue",
"144" = "purple4"
))
p <- p + geom_vline(aes(x = 0), linetype = 2) + geom_hline(aes(x = 0),
linetype = 2)
p <- p + xlab("Coordinate 1") + ylab("Coordinate 2")
print(p, vp = vplayout(1, 1))

I would get a kde estimates but no idea about what density does it use
to plot.

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Default levels of kde estimates in geom_density2d
parts:
It's not at all documented, but stat_density2d uses stat_contour to
draw the contours, which by default generates 10 pretty breaks. You
can use the breaks argument to pick your own.

Hadley
